name: Dial Tone
description: The machine's code is written on a call centre floor that answers no calls. Three floors of desks stand between you and the roof, and the supervisor's vault with the password lies halfway up. As the soldier, fight along each floor past the guards and through the cubicle walls. As the hacker, climb into the cable ducts above the ceilings: put on the goggles for the hidden ledge, fetch USB keys, hack the computers that open the duct doors and switch off the laser. Both routes meet at the shafts between the floors.
